## Summary

Describe the workflow, evidence or documentation change.

## Evidence and methodology checks

- [ ] I did not commit restricted full-text documents or generated databases.
- [ ] New sources have stable IDs, provenance and rights notes.
- [ ] Raw values, units and source locators are retained.
- [ ] AI-produced observations remain candidates until human review.
- [ ] System-boundary or normalization changes are documented.
- [ ] `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
